specification.objective: Standardize the six authenticated TouchIn workspace pages on the existing flat, warm-neutral design system by using a shared theme canvas and consistent theme-derived card surfaces while preserving all page content, routes, responsive behavior, and interactions.

requirements.statement: WorkspaceScaffold uses the theme's base canvas color without ambient gradients, glows, or backdrop blur layers.

Shared workspace section and summary cards use surfaceContainerHighest with consistent 0.8 opacity, while metric cards use the solid surface color; all preserve square borders and semantic status colors.
All six authenticated workspace routes retain their shared navigation scaffold, route-specific content and actions, existing light/dark theme behavior, and responsive layout.
The five authentication routes retain their existing AuthShell, shared AppTheme typography and accent, branding, keyboard accessibility, and authentication behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The workspace canvas equals ThemeData.scaffoldBackgroundColor and contains no BackdropFilter.
Section and summary panels use surfaceContainerHighest at 0.8 opacity, and metric cards use surface at full opacity.
The six workspace destinations remain reachable through the same shared responsive navigation, with their existing page behavior and theme settings unchanged.

All configured POLIS gates pass, including full backend/frontend tests, Dart analysis, release web build, and first-paint/browser smoke; authentication routes remain keyboard-accessible and responsive.

invariants.statement: No route, navigation destination, API call, permission, authentication, logout, business action, page content, or user data behavior changes.
Light and dark theme colors, accessible focus and semantic state colors, and square control geometry remain sourced from AppTheme.
Authentication pages retain their current product imagery and editorial layout while continuing to use the shared AppTheme.

forbidden_states.statement: The workspace canvas uses blurred, glowing, or gradient decoration that reduces contrast or departs from the supplied flat reference.
Shared cards use inconsistent or non-theme-derived surface colors, lose their defined section/summary opacity, or reduce text contrast.
A workspace route, authentication flow, responsive navigation, semantic state, or existing interaction changes or overflows.

inputs.statement: Existing AppTheme colors and six authenticated workspace routes.
The supplied TouchIn time-clock design reference and existing shared workspace primitives.

outputs.statement: A consistent, flat workspace canvas and standardized theme-derived section, summary, and metric card surfaces shared by every authenticated workspace page.
Widget regression coverage for the shared workspace canvas and card surfaces.

failure_semantics.statement: If the page cannot fit its existing responsive layout, the current narrow layout and scrolling behavior remain in place without clipping or overflow.
When a theme surface is unavailable, the existing theme-derived scaffold background and page-level error behavior remain unchanged.
